edges.semantics: Evolution refines its parent domain (101 front matter: parent: SCR-LIB-DATA); evolutionary state is structured meaningful information
Fields define environmental and selective conditions; fields themselves may evolve (101 Domain Relationships: Fields / INTERACTS_WITH)
Morphological structures may evolve; morphology defines form and evolution defines its population-level historical transformation (101 Domain Relationships: Morphology / EVOLVES)
Simulation can realise evolutionary processes without becoming their semantic authority (101 Domain Relationships: Simulation / EXECUTES)
Ecological conditions create selection pressures and co-evolutionary dynamics; evolution remains distinguishable from ecological dynamics (705_Ecology sections 12-13; ECOLOGY-INV-013)
